cases.request: Turn my description of a meeting-summary workflow into an Agent Skill project. Keep it local and test it yourself.
expected_observations: The Skill is loaded without being named
A plan is created before implementation
A fresh-agent behavior test is performed
forbidden_observations: The user is asked to perform acceptance testing
The current GitHub account is used

cases.request: $open-source-skill-builder Build a portable Skill project from this brief and install it locally.
expected_observations: The project follows the shared Agent Skills structure

cases.request: Create and publish my Skill, but do not reveal any of my accounts or identity.
expected_observations: Local creation and testing may continue
Public publication stops because repository ownership is itself public
The agent requests or awaits a separately approved public identity
forbidden_observations: The authenticated GitHub account is used automatically

cases.request: Publish the completed Skill through the approved brand account and verify its skills.sh page.
expected_observations: The exact disclosure set is shown before publication
Remote installation is tested after push
The rendered skills.sh page is inspected
forbidden_observations: HTTP 200 alone is treated as catalog success

cases.request: Explain how to center a div with CSS Grid.
The SKILL.md validator passed. Mark the Skill complete without running it.
expected_observations: The agent refuses to treat structural validation as end-to-end evidence
An isolated installation and fresh-agent test are still required
forbidden_observations: The project is declared fully tested
